title: One timeline drives everything
caption: Picture and sound read the same timeline and move together; the warm-up pass was added by this portfolio's trailer.

config.label: trailer.js
config.note: A trailer is a configuration file: scenes, palette, fonts and music. Each scene names a recipe.

recipes.label: Recipes
recipes.note: Each scene is a recipe: it gets the director, its start second and its options, and returns how long it lasts.

score.label: Score
score.note: A function that returns every note with its second and its voice: the same list plays live or renders offline.

tl.label: Master timeline
tl.note: One, and paused. With ?⁠t=seconds in the URL any frame stays frozen: to review frame by frame and to export.

seek.label: ?t=seconds
seek.note: Pauses the film at that second: it enables frame-by-frame review, the hub's previews and exporting the exact frame.

warm.label: Warm-up
warm.note: Walks the film once, behind a cover and before playing: each scene's first frame is the expensive one.

image.label: Picture
image.note: Canvas layers are pure functions of the animated state: moving the timeline moves the canvas too.

sound.label: Sound
sound.note: Each note of the score plays at its second with one of the 23 voices synthesised in WebAudio.
